asset.name: Form Store
asset.description: The field-granular store factory owning values, defaults, dirtiness, touched state, validation, dependencies, submission, autosave, and conflict state.

requires.reason: One store per form instance; nested forms must not share state.

rationale: Field-granular by construction: subscribing to whole-form state is the defect that makes large generated forms unusable, and it is far cheaper to prevent here than to retrofit.
